faqSection.sectionSubtitle: Find immediate answers to key inquiries regarding our financial advisory model, accounting standards, and engagement scopes.

faqs.question: What core financial advisory services does YoungMark Global Advisory offer?
faqs.answer: We deliver an integrated suite of corporate financial services: fractional Virtual CFO leadership, full-cycle bookkeeping, Accounts Payable/Receivable management, custom MIS reporting, tax planning & compliance, internal controls design, and specialized real estate fund accounting.

faqs.question: How does outsourcing Accounts Payable and Receivable optimize our cash flow?
faqs.answer: Outsourcing AR and AP standardizes the entire invoicing, collection, and vendor payout workflow. We reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) through structured customer follow-ups and automated collection reminders, while ensuring AP disbursements capture early-pay discounts and avoid duplicate charges.

faqs.question: What is MIS reporting and why is it critical for executive leadership?
faqs.answer: Management Information Systems (MIS) provide customized, real-time executive dashboards that extract key performance indicators across revenue, gross margins, customer acquisition costs, and departmental burn. Instead of waiting weeks for retrospective reports, leadership gains instant data to make agile business bets.

faqs.question: How does the Virtual CFO engagement model work?
faqs.answer: Our Virtual CFO service provides senior strategic financial leadership on a flexible fractional retainer. We handle multi-scenario forecasting, capital raise preparation, investor deck builds, bank covenant reviews, and participation in executive board meetings without the $300k+ overhead of an in-house hire.

faqs.question: Which accounting software systems and ERPs do you support?
faqs.answer: Our Chartered Accountants are certified across QuickBooks Online, Oracle NetSuite Financials, Xero, Zoho Books, Sage Intacct, and ERPNext, ensuring seamless adoption of your existing accounting tech stack.

faqs.question: What specific expertise do you offer for Yardi and Real Estate accounting?
faqs.answer: Our real estate specialists manage Yardi Voyager and Breeze financial ledgers for commercial and residential operators. Services include CAM expense pooling, lease abstracting, tenant rent roll reconciliations, and custom monthly financial reporting packages.

faqs.question: Do you partner with cross-border, international, and multi-currency clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. A substantial portion of our client base operates across the US, UK, Middle East, Canada, and India. We manage multi-currency revaluations, intercompany transfers, transfer pricing schedules, and localized compliance reporting seamlessly.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee client data privacy and fiduciary confidentiality?
faqs.answer: We mandate military-grade end-to-end encryption (AES-256), multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access control, and strict non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) to protect all sensitive corporate financial information.

termsOfService.intro: These Master Advisory Terms of Service constitute a legally binding agreement between YoungMark Global Advisory and the corporate client entity. By engaging our advisory, accounting, fractional CFO, or MIS services, you affirm acceptance of these terms.

sections.heading: 1. Scope of Engagement & Professional Standards
sections.body: YoungMark Global Advisory delivers financial management, fractional CFO advisory, corporate bookkeeping, tax planning, and business intelligence services in accordance with established GAAP/IFRS standards. Deliverables are prepared based on transactional records and declarations furnished by the Client.

sections.heading: 2. Client Obligations & Data Integrity
sections.body: The Client agrees to grant timely, accurate, and unencumbered access to source bank accounts, merchant portals, invoicing streams, and corporate ledgers. YoungMark shall not be liable for regulatory penalties resulting from falsified or withheld client data.

sections.heading: 3. Fiduciary Duty & Strict Confidentiality
sections.body: YoungMark acknowledges and assumes a binding fiduciary standard with respect to Client financial records. All proprietary corporate records, cap tables, margins, and banking feeds remain strictly confidential and subject to institutional non-disclosure covenants.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property & Deliverables
sections.body: Upon receipt of due advisory compensation, all custom board decks, MIS reports, and financial models generated specifically for the Client become the exclusive property of the Client entity.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted under applicable corporate law, YoungMark's aggregate financial liability arising out of or related to advisory engagements shall not exceed the total advisory fees paid by the Client in the trailing 12-month period.

sections.heading: 6. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
sections.body: These Terms of Service and any contractual disputes shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Uttar Pradesh, India, with exclusive jurisdiction in Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida).

privacyPolicy.intro: At YoungMark Global Advisory, protecting confidential financial records, executive identities, and corporate transactional telemetry is our utmost institutional priority.

sections.heading: 1. Categories of Information Collected
sections.body: We collect corporate entity information, banking statements, transaction registers, tax identifier numbers, payroll registers, and authorized executive contact details required to execute fiduciary engagements.

sections.heading: 2. Institutional Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Client information is processed solely for preparing statutory reconciliations, executive management packs, tax filings, payroll disbursements, and fiduciary advisory deliverables.

sections.heading: 3. Zero Third-Party Monetization Policy
sections.body: YoungMark maintains a strict policy: we do not sell, license, monetize, or disclose client financial records or personal identities to any third-party advertisers, brokers, or data clearinghouses.

sections.heading: 4. Military-Grade Encryption & Cloud Architecture
sections.body: All financial records are encrypted at rest using AES-256 bit encryption and in transit using TLS 1.3. Access is restricted via multi-factor biometric authentication and role-based clearance hierarchies.

sections.heading: 5. Corporate Data Retention & Permanent Deletion
sections.body: Records are retained strictly for the duration mandated by statutory tax and corporate audit regulations. Upon contractual termination and satisfaction of statutory holding requirements, records are permanently purged.

cookiePolicy.intro: YoungMark Global Advisory uses strictly essential and functional session tokens to facilitate secure client navigation, theme preference retention, and anonymous server telemetry.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies and Tokens?
sections.body: Small encrypted text files stored on your local browser to authenticate session continuity, remember dark-mode preferences, and prevent malicious Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

sections.heading: 2. Essential Operational Cookies
sections.body: These tokens are technically strictly required for site navigation, intro animation status preservation, and secure consultation modal dispatch.

sections.heading: 3. Managing Your Preferences
sections.body: You may block or delete cookies via your browser settings at any time; however, blocking essential cookies may impact interactive portal functionality.
